name: Miso Gravy (Triple Batch)
description: The gravy from the Miso-Chestnut Mushroom Wellington, tripled so there is enough for the Wellington, biscuits and turkey, plus leftovers.
ingredients: 1.1 liters low-sodium vegetable stock, plus a splash for reheating
steps: Finely chop the shallots and mince the garlic. Strip the thyme leaves. Whisk the miso into the sherry so it dissolves without lumps.
Melt the butter in a medium saucepan over medium heat. Cook the shallots and garlic for 2 to 3 minutes, until soft. Stir in the flour and cook for 1 minute.
Slowly whisk in the stock, a ladle at a time at first so no lumps form. Bring to a simmer and cook, whisking now and then, for 8 to 10 minutes, until it coats a spoon.
Off the heat, whisk in the miso-sherry mix and the thyme. Taste; the miso brings enough salt for most people.
To serve after chilling, rewarm over low heat for about 10 minutes, whisking in a splash of stock, since it thickens a lot in the fridge.
notes: Swaps (only if needed; don't buy both): port instead of dry sherry, same amount.
Make ahead: keeps 4 days in the fridge, or freeze for up to 3 months. Whisk well when reheating.
Shopping: one 32 oz (946 ml) carton of stock isn't enough. Buy two cartons, or a 1.5 liter one.
Ginger check: read the labels on the miso and the vegetable stock.
